name: revert_document
description: Restore an earlier SAVED state as a new head commit (history is append-only; refs never move). Target one commit: {steps:N} walks back N saved commits from the head (1 = the previous saved commit, must be < totalCommits) OR {commitOid:"<40-hex>"} jumps to that commit (mutually exclusive). Bare reverts fail closed: unsaved execute_batch edits refuse with E_CONFLICT unless discardUnsaved:true, which discards them. The conflict remedy names net-zero edits (pending revisions count as dirty even when content matches) and carries dirtyReason with the pending count. Discarded unsaved edits are echoed back as {wasDirty,discardedNodeCount,discardedNodeIds} (counts + ids only, bounded), never silently dropped. Optional author (<=100 chars, default ASTra Agent) + reason (<=500 chars): when either is given the commit subject follows `Revert [N steps] to <oid> by <author>[: reason]`; otherwise the legacy `Revert to <oid>[: message]` shape is kept (message still accepted), and a bare default revert quotes the target commit message in the new subject (`Revert to <oid>: "<target message>"`). Example {"sessionId":"sess_abc","steps":1} -> {ok:true,revertedToCommit,revision,dirty:false,discardedUnsaved,commitOid,commitMessage}. The pre-revert state is kept for redo_document. Selective middle-undo recipe (no cherry-pick: restore the older keeper, then re-apply the kept newer edits): 1) preview_revert the target, 2) revert_document to the older keeper commit, 3) inspect/search for fresh anchors (node ids die on every revert; never reuse pre-revert ids), 4) execute_batch to re-apply the kept newer edits, 5) save_document. Export-check after every mutation: run export_document (or inspect_document) after each revert and each re-apply and confirm the bytes before the next step. ECMA-376 essentials: colors are hex without # (e.g. 4F46E5, never #4F46E5); font sizes are half-points in w:sz (e.g. 28 = 14pt, 22 = 11pt); spacing/margins/cellMar use twips dxa (twentieths of a point, e.g. 240 = 12pt, 180 = 9pt); borders use eighths-of-a-point sz (e.g. 32 = 4pt left accent). Workflow: open_document -> inspect_document -> search_content -> execute_batch -> save_document -> close_document. Always inspect first, batch second, save third. Single edit = 1-item batch. Never call twice when once suffices.
